
# Setup

Import necessary libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(dbscan)
```

Set default projection, tmap settings, and standard distance for deduplication (in metres)
```{r}
crs = 32636

tmap_mode(mode = "view")

distance_dedup = 50
```

# Import Data

## Apac/Kwania Boundaries
```{r}
apac_kwania = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Apac Kwania/ApacKwania.shp"), crs)
```


## Town Centres

```{r}
aduku = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Town Centres/aduku town centre/aduku_town_centre.shp"), crs)%>%
  mutate(town = "Aduku")%>%
  select(town)
apac = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Town Centres/apac town centre/apac_town_centre.shp"), crs)%>%
  mutate(town = "Apac")%>%
  select(town)

town_centres = rbind(aduku, apac)

rm(aduku, apac)
```


## Raw water source data

Import datasets, ensuring standardised projection, and creating columns to for water source and dataset ID (which will be useful in the deduplication process below)
```{r}
everflow = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Water Sources/everflow_raw.gpkg"), crs)%>%
  st_join(., town_centres)%>%
  mutate(dataset = "everflow", 
         id = paste("everflow", site_num, sep = "_"))

study = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Water Sources/study_raw.gpkg"), crs)%>%
  st_join(., town_centres)%>%
  mutate(dataset = "study",
         id = paste("study", village_so, sep = "_"))

tgs = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Water Sources/tgs_raw.gpkg"), crs)%>%
  st_join(., town_centres)%>%
  mutate(dataset = "tgs",
         id = paste("tgs", FID_, sep = "_"))
         
ministry = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Water Sources/ministry_WPDx_raw.gpkg"), crs)%>%
  st_join(., town_centres)%>%
  mutate(dataset = "ministry", 
         id = paste("ministry", row_id, sep = "_"))

lifeline = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Water Sources/lifeline_WPDx_raw.gpkg"), crs)%>%
  st_join(., town_centres)%>%
  mutate(dataset = "lifeline", 
         id = paste("lifeline", row_id, sep = "_"))
```

# Set up and standardisation
Prioritisation of datasets (based on confidence in the information provided for each water source)
```{r}
study$priority = 1
tgs$priority = 2
everflow$priority = 3
lifeline$priority = 4
ministry$priority = 5
```


Now, we want to make sure all datasets have the same columns, so that we can successfully combine the datasets
```{r}
everflow_standardised = everflow%>%
  rename(village = Village, source_name = Source_Nam)%>%
  mutate(year = NA, source_type = NA, dwd = NA, source_type = "Borehole")
rm(everflow)

study_standardised = study%>%
  rename(village = village_na, source_name = source_n_1, source_type = source_typ, dwd = dwd_num, lat = location_g, long = location_1)%>%
  mutate(year_insta = na_if(year_insta, 0),
    year = ifelse(!is.na(exact_inst), year(as.Date(exact_inst, format = "%d-%b-%y")), year_insta))
rm(study)

tgs_standardised = tgs%>%
  mutate(year = year(DateofCons))%>%
  rename(lat = Y, long = X, village = Village, dwd = dwd_no_suf, source_name = Name, source_type = SourceType)
rm(tgs)

ministry_standardised = ministry%>%
  mutate(village = NA, source_name = NA, dwd = NA)%>%
  rename(lat = lat_deg, long = lon_deg, year = install_ye, source_type = water_tech)
rm(ministry)

lifeline_standardised = lifeline%>%
  mutate(village = NA, source_name = NA, dwd = NA)%>%
  rename(lat = lat_deg, long = lon_deg, year = install_ye, source_type = water_sour)
rm(lifeline)
```


Categorise source types in order to facilitate deduplication once we combine the datasets
```{r}
source_type_categories = bind_rows(everflow_standardised%>%select(source_type, dataset), lifeline_standardised%>%select(source_type, dataset), ministry_standardised%>%select(source_type, dataset), study_standardised%>%select(source_type, dataset), tgs_standardised%>%select(source_type, dataset))%>%
  data.frame()%>%
  mutate(source_type_categorised = case_when(
    grepl("Rain Water|Rainwater|rain catchment", source_type, ignore.case = T) ~ "Rainwater Harvesting",
    grepl("Deep Borehole|DBH|Borehole|Lined Well|Protected Shallow Well|Protected dug well|under ground pumped", source_type, ignore.case = T) | source_type %in% c("D", "S", "SW", "Shallow well") | (dataset == "tgs" & is.na(source_type)) ~ "Borehole / Protected Well",
    grepl("Valley Tank|Dam connected", source_type, ignore.case = T) | source_type %in% c("dam", "Dam", "valley dam") ~ "Dam",
    grepl("Open Well|Unlined|Unprotected dug well", source_type, ignore.case = T) ~ "Unprotected Well",
    source_type %in% c("Protected Spring", "Protected spring", "Protected Spring Catchment", "SP") | grepl("Pii me paipo", source_type) ~ "Protected Spring",
    grepl("Unprotected Spring", source_type, ignore.case = T) ~ "Unprotected Spring",
    grepl("Tap Stand|Yard Tap|Public Stand Post|Public tap", source_type, ignore.case = T) ~ "Public Tap",
    grepl("Private Tap|Piped into compound", source_type) ~ "Private Tap",
    grepl("Lake|Pond|River|Surface water", source_type, ignore.case = T) ~ "Surface Water",
    T ~ NA))%>%
  arrange(source_type_categorised)%>%
  select(1, 4, 2)%>%
  unique()
```

Update these categorisations in each individual dataset
```{r}
everflow_standardised = left_join(everflow_standardised, source_type_categories, by = c("source_type", "dataset"))
tgs_standardised = left_join(tgs_standardised, source_type_categories, by = c("source_type", "dataset"))
study_standardised = left_join(study_standardised, source_type_categories, by = c("source_type", "dataset"))
ministry_standardised = left_join(ministry_standardised, source_type_categories, by = c("source_type", "dataset"))
lifeline_standardised = left_join(lifeline_standardised, source_type_categories, by = c("source_type", "dataset"))
```

# Deduplication

See deduplication protocol [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SclvtB8JBEbSVTBPWrrV_sA2K45God_-OUuH3pwWHTI/edit?tab=t.0)

## Deduplication within datasets

### TGS

First, let's remove any dry or failed boreholes. We'll also get rid of duplicates with the exact same coordinates (or Northing/Easting), or the same DWD (not counting water sources with NAs for DWD).
```{r}
tgs_dedup = tgs_standardised%>%
  mutate(dwd = na_if(dwd, 0),
         source_name = str_to_lower(source_name))%>%
  distinct(Northing, Easting, .keep_all = T)%>%
  filter(!grepl("dry|failed", status, ignore.case = T))%>%
  select(id, dwd, village, source_name, source_type_categorised, year, lat, long, dataset, town, priority)

tgs_dedup = tgs_dedup%>%
  filter(!is.na(dwd))%>%
  distinct(dwd, .keep_all = T)%>%
  rbind(tgs_dedup%>%filter(is.na(dwd)))
```

```{r}
coords <- st_coordinates(tgs_dedup)

# Step 3: Run DBSCAN with 50 meter epsilon and minPts = 1
# (minPts = 1 ensures each point gets a cluster, even if alone)
db <- dbscan::dbscan(coords, eps = 50, minPts = 1)

# Step 4: Add cluster to original sf
tgs_dedup$cluster <- db$cluster

tgs_dedup%>%
  data.frame()%>%
  group_by(cluster)%>%
  filter(n()>1)

tgs_dedup_final = tgs_dedup%>%
  distinct(cluster, .keep_all = T)%>%
  mutate(delete_semi = duplicated(cluster),
         delete_agg = duplicated(cluster))
```

### Study

Similarly, for our study dataset, we'll get rid of any duplicates with the exact same coordinates, or same DWD (again, not counting water sources with NAs for DWD). We'll also get rid of sources that denote Lake Kwania, since we'll bring in the actual spatial boundary of Lake Kwania later on. 
```{r}
study_dedup = study_standardised%>%
  mutate(dwd = na_if(dwd, "."))%>%
  arrange(dwd)%>%
  filter(long != 0)

study_dedup = study_dedup%>%
  filter(!is.na(dwd))%>%
  distinct(dwd, .keep_all = T)%>%
  rbind(., study_dedup%>%filter(is.na(dwd)))%>%
  filter(str_to_title(source_name) != "Lake Kwania" | is.na(source_name))%>%
  select(id, dwd, village, source_name, source_type_categorised, year, lat, long, dataset, town, priority)
```

```{r}
coords <- st_coordinates(study_dedup)

# Step 3: Run DBSCAN with 50 meter epsilon and minPts = 1.(minPts = 1 ensures each point gets a cluster, even if alone)
db <- dbscan::dbscan(coords, eps = 50, minPts = 1)

# Add cluster to original sf
study_dedup$cluster <- db$cluster

study_dedup%>%
  data.frame()%>%
  group_by(cluster)%>%
  filter(n()>1)%>%
  arrange(cluster)

study_dedup_final = study_dedup %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
      group_modify(~ {
        if (nrow(.x) == 1) {.x}  # keep singleton
        else if (n_distinct(.x$village) == 1) {.x}  # all same village, keep all
        else {.x[1, , drop = FALSE]}}) %>% # different villages, keep only one
      ungroup()%>%
  mutate(delete_semi = duplicated(cluster),
         delete_agg = duplicated(cluster))
```



### Everflow
```{r}
everflow_dedup = everflow_standardised%>%
  distinct(lat, long, .keep_all = T)%>%
  filter(lat > 0)%>%
  select(id, dwd, village, source_name, source_type_categorised, year, lat, long, dataset, town, priority)
```

```{r}
coords <- st_coordinates(everflow_dedup)
db <- dbscan::dbscan(coords, eps = 50, minPts = 1)
everflow_dedup$cluster <- db$cluster

everflow_dedup%>%
  data.frame()%>%
  group_by(cluster)%>%
  filter(n()>1)

everflow_dedup_final = everflow_dedup%>%
  distinct(cluster, .keep_all = T)%>%
  mutate(delete_semi = duplicated(cluster),
         delete_agg = duplicated(cluster))
```

### Ministry
```{r}
ministry_dedup = ministry_standardised%>%
  distinct(lat, long, .keep_all = T)%>%
  select(id, dwd, village, source_name, source_type_categorised, year, lat, long, dataset, town, priority)
```

```{r}
coords <- st_coordinates(ministry_dedup)
db <- dbscan::dbscan(coords, eps = 50, minPts = 1)
ministry_dedup$cluster <- db$cluster

ministry_dedup%>%
  data.frame()%>%
  group_by(cluster)%>%
  filter(n()>1)%>%
  arrange(cluster)

# Conservative deduplication
ministry_dedup_final <- ministry_dedup %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    
    #keep all sources in town centre
    if (any(!is.na(.x$town))) {.x} 
    
     #keep all sources on their own (not within 50m)
    else if (nrow(.x) == 1) {.x}
    
    #if cluster has multiple points and multiple source types, keep one per source type
    else if (n_distinct(.x$source_type_categorised) == 1) {.x[1, , drop = FALSE]} 
    else {.x}}) %>%
  ungroup()%>%

# Semi deletion flag: TRUE for duplicates within same cluster & source_type, regardless of town centre
  group_by(cluster, source_type_categorised) %>%
  mutate(
    row_num_within_type = row_number(),  # tag which is the first in source_type
    delete_semi = row_num_within_type > 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-row_num_within_type) %>%
  
  # Agg deletion flag: TRUE for all except first per cluster
  mutate(delete_agg = duplicated(cluster)) %>%
  arrange(cluster)

ministry_dedup_final%>%data.frame()

multisource_clusters = ministry_dedup%>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  filter(n() > 1 & n_distinct(source_type_categorised) > 1) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  arrange(cluster)

tm_shape(ministry_dedup%>%filter(cluster %in% multisource_clusters$cluster)%>%mutate(cluster = as.factor(cluster)))+
  tm_dots(col = "cluster", legend.show = F, popup.vars = T)+
  tm_basemap("Esri.WorldImagery")
```

## Duplicates across datasets

### Combining Lifeline/Ministry

```{r}
wdpx_comb = st_as_sf(rbind(ministry_dedup_final, lifeline_dedup_final), crs = crs)%>%
  arrange(priority)
```

```{r}
coords <- st_coordinates(wdpx_comb)
db <- dbscan::dbscan(coords, eps = 50, minPts = 1)
wdpx_comb$cluster <- db$cluster

# Conservative deduplication
wdpx_dedup <- wdpx_comb %>%
  group_by(cluster, source_type_categorised) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    
    # Keep all sources in town centre
    if (any(!is.na(.x$town))) {
      .x
    }
    
    # Keep singletons
    else if (nrow(.x) == 1) {
      .x
    }
    
    # All from same dataset: keep all
    else if (n_distinct(.x$dataset) == 1) {
      .x
    }

    # Otherwise (multiple datasets): keep one
    else {
      .x[1, , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup()%>%

# Semi deletion flag: TRUE for duplicates within same cluster & source_type, regardless of town centre
  group_by(cluster, source_type_categorised) %>%
  mutate(
    n_datasets = n_distinct(dataset),
    row_num_within_type = row_number(),
    delete_semi = case_when(
      n_datasets > 1 & row_num_within_type > 1 ~ T, T ~ delete_semi))%>%  # retain previous TRUEs
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-row_num_within_type, -n_datasets)%>%
  
  # Agg deletion flag: same as semi, but keep existing TRUE values
  mutate(delete_agg = ifelse(delete_semi == T, T, delete_agg),  # keep existing TRUE values
         consolidated = "wdpx") %>%
  arrange(cluster)
```


```{r, eval = F}
wdpx_dedup%>%data.frame()%>%
  filter(cluster == 3)
  filter(id == "lifeline_338999")

multisource_clusters = wdpx_dedup%>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  filter(n() > 1 & n_distinct(source_type_categorised) > 1) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  arrange(cluster)

tm_shape(wdpx_comb%>%filter(cluster == 124))+
  tm_dots(col = "dataset", legend.show = F, popup.vars = T)+
  tm_basemap("Esri.WorldImagery")
```



### Combining WDPx / Everflow

```{r}
wdpx_everflow_comb = st_as_sf(rbind(wdpx_dedup, everflow_dedup_final%>%mutate(consolidated = "everflow")), crs = crs)%>%
  arrange(priority)
```

```{r}
coords <- st_coordinates(wdpx_everflow_comb)
db <- dbscan::dbscan(coords, eps = 50, minPts = 1)
wdpx_everflow_comb$cluster <- db$cluster

# Conservative deduplication. semi and agg columns are the same as conservative for this operation
wdpx_everflow_dedup <- wdpx_everflow_comb %>%
  group_by(cluster, source_type_categorised) %>%
  mutate(n_consolidated = n_distinct(consolidated)) %>%
  filter(n_consolidated == 1 | row_number() == 1) %>%  # if multiple consolidated values, keep only one
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n_consolidated)%>%
  mutate(consolidated = "wdpx/everflow")
```

```{r, eval = F}
multisource_clusters = wdpx_everflow_comb%>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  filter(n() > 1 & n_distinct(consolidated) > 1) %>%
  #filter(n_distinct(source_type_categorised) > 1 )%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  arrange(cluster)

multisource_clusters%>%data.frame()

tm_shape(wdpx_everflow_comb%>%filter(cluster == 301))+
  tm_dots(col = "dataset", legend.show = F, popup.vars = T)+
  tm_basemap("Esri.WorldImagery")
```


### Combining WDPx/Everflow with TGS

```{r}
wdpx_everflow_tgs_comb = st_as_sf(rbind(wdpx_everflow_dedup, tgs_dedup_final%>%mutate(consolidated = "tgs")), crs = crs)%>%
  arrange(priority)
```

```{r}
coords <- st_coordinates(wdpx_everflow_tgs_comb)
db <- dbscan::dbscan(coords, eps = 50, minPts = 1)
wdpx_everflow_tgs_comb$cluster <- db$cluster

# Conservative deduplication
wdpx_everflow_tgs_dedup <- wdpx_everflow_tgs_comb %>%
  group_by(cluster, source_type_categorised, year) %>%
  mutate(n_consolidated = n_distinct(consolidated)) %>%
  filter(n_consolidated == 1 | row_number() == 1) %>%  # if multiple consolidated values, keep only one
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n_consolidated)%>%
  
   # Semi deduplication flag: across all years, for same cluster + source_type
  group_by(cluster, source_type_categorised) %>%
  mutate(
    n_datasets = n_distinct(consolidated),
    row_num_within_type = row_number(),
    delete_semi = ifelse(n_datasets > 1 & row_num_within_type > 1, TRUE, delete_semi))%>%  # preserve existing TRUE
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n_datasets, -row_num_within_type)%>%
  mutate(consolidated = "wdpx/everflow/tgs",
         delete_agg = ifelse(delete_semi == TRUE, TRUE, delete_agg))
```

multisource_clusters = wdpx_everflow_tgs_comb%>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  filter(n() > 1 & n_distinct(source_type_categorised) > 1 & n_distinct(consolidated) > 1) %>%
  #filter(!is.na(town))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  arrange(cluster)

multisource_clusters%>%data.frame()
```

tm_shape(multisource_clusters%>%filter(cluster %in% multisource_clusters$cluster))+

```



### Combining WDPx/Everflow/TGS with Study

```{r}
wdpx_everflow_tgs_study_comb = rbind(wdpx_everflow_tgs_dedup, st_as_sf(study_dedup_final%>%mutate(consolidated = "study"), crs = crs))%>%
  arrange(priority)

coords <- st_coordinates(wdpx_everflow_tgs_study_comb)
db <- dbscan::dbscan(coords, eps = 50, minPts = 1)
wdpx_everflow_tgs_study_comb$cluster <- db$cluster

# Conservative deduplication
final_dedup <- wdpx_everflow_tgs_study_comb %>%
  filter(is.na(dwd) | !duplicated(dwd))%>%
  group_by(cluster, source_type_categorised) %>%
  mutate(n_consolidated = n_distinct(consolidated)) %>%
  filter(n_consolidated == 1 | row_number() == 1) %>%  # if multiple consolidated values, keep only one
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n_consolidated)%>%
  
   # agg deduplication flag: across all years, for same cluster + source_type
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    n_datasets = n_distinct(consolidated),
    row_num_within_type = row_number(),
    delete_agg = ifelse(n_datasets > 1 & row_num_within_type > 1, TRUE, delete_agg))%>%  # preserve existing TRUE
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n_datasets, -row_num_within_type)
```

# Final stats and exports

Let's count the number of sources in each dataset
```{r}
paste("Conservative:", nrow(final_dedup))

paste("Semi-Conservative:", nrow(final_dedup%>%filter(delete_semi == F)))

paste("Aggressive:", nrow(final_dedup%>%filter(delete_agg == F)))
```
Clean up column names, create new columns with indicators on source type categories we'll use for analysis, and final filter for only points within 500m radius of Apac/Kwania boundaries
```{r}
final_dedup_formatted = final_dedup%>%
  mutate(
    cons = 1,
    semi = ifelse(delete_semi == F, 1, 0),
    agg = ifelse(delete_agg == F, 1, 0),
    
    private = case_when(source_type_categorised %in% c("Private Tap", "Rainwater Harvesting") ~ 1, T ~ 0),
    
    all = 1,
    nosurf = case_when(!source_type_categorised %in% c("Dam", "Surface Water") ~ 1, T ~ 0),
    imp = case_when(
      grepl("Tap|Rainwater|Borehole", source_type_categorised) | source_type_categorised == "Protected Spring" ~ 1, T ~ 0),
    impyearround = ifelse(imp == 1 & !grepl("Rainwater", source_type_categorised), 1, 0))%>%
  
  rename(town_centre = town)%>%
  select(id, dwd, source_name, year, source_type_categorised, private, all, nosurf, imp, impyearround, lat, long, village, dataset, town_centre, cons, semi, agg)%>%
  st_filter(., st_buffer(apac_kwania, 500), .pred = !st_intersects)
```

Export deduplicated dataset
```{r}
st_write(final_dedup_formatted, "Processed data/water_source_dedups_apr24_2025.gpkg", delete_dsn = T)
#write.csv(final_dedup_formatted, "Processed data/water_source_deduplicates_apr21_2025.csv", row.names = F)
```

Create dataset of all sources (including duplicates for manual inspection in ArcGIS Online)
```{r}
semi = final_dedup_formatted%>%filter(delete_semi == F)
agg = final_dedup_formatted%>%filter(delete_agg == F)

all_dups = rbind(tgs_standardised%>%select(id, dwd, village, source_name, source_type_categorised, year, lat, long, dataset, town, priority), study_standardised%>%select(id, dwd, village, source_name, source_type_categorised, year, lat, long, dataset, town, priority),
      ministry_standardised%>%select(id, dwd, village, source_name, source_type_categorised, year, lat, long, dataset, town, priority),
      lifeline_standardised%>%select(id, dwd, village, source_name, source_type_categorised, year, lat, long, dataset, town, priority),
      everflow_standardised%>%select(id, dwd, village, source_name, source_type_categorised, year, lat, long, dataset, town, priority))%>%
  mutate(in_conservative = ifelse(id %in% final_dedup_formatted$id, 1, 0),
         in_semi = ifelse(id %in% semi$id, 1, 0),
         in_agg = ifelse(id %in% agg$id, 1, 0))

st_write(all_dups, "Processed data/all_duplicates_apr21.shp")
```
